title: Recursive tail state space
statement: Define a family of state spaces indexed by natural numbers recursively: at index $0$, use the write phase for a word of length parameter $1$; at index $k+1$, take the disjoint union of a sweep phase, a seek phase, the state space at index $k$, and another seek phase.
